body:
### Affected package

@terreno/ui

### Kind

Bug

### Problem

Light-mode `text.accent` (`accent700`, `#956A00`) measures 4.32:1 on `surface.baseAlternate` (`#F2F2F2`), below WCAG 1.4.3 AA (4.5:1) for normal text. It passes on `surface.base` (4.84:1) and in dark mode (6.23:1), so the failure only shows on alternate rows and inset panels. `text.accent` is used by CheckBox and the DateTimeActionSheet "today" label.

### Outcome

`text.accent` meets 4.5:1 on both `surface.base` and `surface.baseAlternate` in light and dark.

### Current behavior

1. Install `audit-color-schemes` from TerrenoLabs/terreno-skills, then from an app root (e.g. `example-frontend/`) run `bun <skill>/scripts/contrastAudit.ts`.
2. Row `text.accent on surface.baseAlternate`: light 4.32:1, FAIL light.

### Non-scope

- Accent fills (`border.activeAccent`, accent backgrounds).
- Dark-mode accent text.

### Acceptance

- `contrastAudit.ts` reports `text.accent` at ≥ 4.5:1 on `surface.base` and `surface.baseAlternate` in both modes.
- No demo story's axe scan reports `color-contrast` on accent text in light mode.

### Context

- Found by the `audit-color-schemes` skill (TerrenoLabs/terreno-skills#4).
- Related contrast issues: #1519, #1520, #1522.
title: [Bug]: Accent text fails contrast on baseAlternate in light mode
